design.enemy_level_200_exp_rule: Use normal_enemy_base_exp[199] rather than MapleSEA exp_to_next[200] (an abrupt +286% step) to prevent sudden Lv200 leaderboard EXP inflation.
design.quest_standard_path: 3 main quests + S01/S03/S05 side quests + independent first-clear boss subreward; completing 2 additional sides accelerates progression.
design.quest_payout_weighting: Normalize current region fixed XP pool across target-level weighted M01(2), M02(1.8), M03(2), S01(.7), S03(.7), S05(.7), Boss(1.5); S02/S04 are extra optional acceleration.
design.quest_reward_level_lock: fixed by quest ID/recommended level and version; report at Lv200 must not upscale early region reward.

daily_extra_exp_draft.bonus_sources: reference eligible target enemy level; ignore paid EXP potion
daily_extra_exp_draft.reset_rule: one main + two extras per day globally, no next-day hard gate

design.leaderboard_and_potion: Separate lifetime base EXP from actual boosted EXP; include fixed quest rewards in base once; preserve Level200 overflow tally; rankings / paid EXP implementation subject to in-game ability and terms.
design.endgame_fixed_reward_budget_policy: Unallocated target budget, not automatically granted. High-difficulty/Spiral first clears are optional; missing share may be earned by hunting instead. Values are not assignments to individual boss quests.
design.next_step: Simulate actual stage order, quest acceptance, gear-limited kill speeds, daily resets, and co-op, then adjust XP. Cap/quest totals not silently converted to production balance.
